_format: node = tree / slot+option; oldFx -> newFx; newName null = keep the old Turkish name; newDesc = Turkish description regenerated from the new fx (G rows have none). Applied by tools/apply-talent-patch.mjs
_note: p.threat / p.store keys in the new fx are checked by tools/talents-check.mjs against the target skill params. PM-TAL deviations from plate-melee.md f2: spec:knight_blademaster / s17A uses sdur=avatar (the status knight_avatar applies; f2 said wings, a no-op); skillSpecs knight_charge 2A is "M knight_charge p.pathWidth*=1.5" (f2 said rng=+3: a banned verb for a specialisation, T2 needs a form verb).
